gold.title: messages is stored in lockstep with platform and is always platform?.messages — inline the projection at its one reader
gold.description: Session.messages is written at exactly two sites (the constructor and apply), each immediately after platform is set from the same manifest, as manifest.platform?.messages ?? []. It is a projection of platform with one reader (bannerText). Drop the field and read session.platform?.messages ?? [] at the read site.

candidate.title: `Session.messages` is a stored projection of `Session.platform`
candidate.description: `messages` is written in lockstep with `platform` from the same source at every write site, duplicating data that could be read directly from `platform.messages`. Future write paths risk forgetting to update both. Fix: delete `messages: string[];` (line 5) and both assignments (lines 9, 14); inline the projection at the single read site in `src/banner.ts:4` as `(session.platform?.messages ?? []).join(" · ")`
